h: Correctional officers probed after two death-row inmates escape in Ilorin
p: About 20 correctional officers are reportedly under investigation after two death-row inmates escaped from the Oke-Kura custodial centre in Ilorin. The service has confirmed the probe but not the number of officers involved.
body: About 20 officers of the Nigerian Correctional Service are reportedly under investigation after two death-row inmates escaped from the Medium Security Custodial Centre at Oke-Kura, Ilorin, Kwara State, last Wednesday.

Those affected are said to include members of the armed squad and duty officers responsible for supervising inmates around the clock. Sources described the breach as a coordinated escape attempt involving seven inmates, two of whom got away.

The Kwara State Command of the service confirmed on Sunday, 22 November 2026, that an investigation had begun on the orders of the Controller-General of Corrections. Its spokesperson said the probe would be thorough, but declined to confirm how many officers had been questioned, saying it would be premature while the investigation was ongoing.
more: Two death-row inmates escaped last Wednesday.
About 20 officers are reportedly being questioned.
The service says the probe will be thorough.
